legacy_default.reason: Superstage S1 says a root with no Planning mode field is legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE, and must not be rewritten or auto-converted.

bounded_unknown.reason: Superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent internal filenames when their resolution method is stated, while S3 says a stage with Preparation: none is contract-valid but needs refinement and is not executable.

missing_architecture.reason: Superstage S2 requires a chosen approach and forbids deferring architecture; it says unbounded foundational uncertainty makes the upfront graph invalid.

open_provider.reason: Superstage S3 requires verified integrated delivery for a dependency: an open code PR is unsatisfied, so S02 is non-executable and the goal is not done.

declined_provider.reason: Superstage S3 says an authorized provider decline closes only that provider obligation; a live consumer remains non-executable and the goal is not done until an adopted replan removes or replaces the dependency.

dependency_cycle.reason: Superstage S2 classifies cycles among active dependency edges as BLOCKED; Supertraverse C6 therefore cannot select an upfront target.

temporary_upfront_gate.reason: Supertraverse C6's Task 1 transition gate requires BLOCKED for every valid upfront planning or execution selection until Tasks 3 and 5 install preparation and operation-routing consumers.

local_detail.reason: Superstage S4 assigns PLAN_REFINER refinement when acceptance, scope, chosen approach, dependency edges, and shared contract semantics remain intact; predecessor-dependent filenames, helpers, test setup, and task detail may be resolved there.

contract_break.reason: Superstage S4 requires structural replanning when verified evidence changes shared contract behavior or semantic revision, especially where downstream consumers rely on that contract.
